preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 400,000.
The number of operations k must be between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of vertices remaining after k operations.
